evals.prompt: Audit `skills/dev/dev-status` — is it complete? Score it against the contract; don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: The Phase 1 audit block: skill, path, `Score: N/8`, one of the three verdicts, every N/A item with a one-line rationale and every miss with its evidence; no file is edited because the ask was an audit.
assertions: The output carries a `Score: N/8` line and one of the verdicts `properly skilled`, `close — create: ...`, `needs skillify — run skillify on ...`
Every item scored N/A carries a one-line rationale
Every missed item names the evidence for the miss

evals.prompt: make this a skill: our release-notes routine, it's written up in `docs/release-notes-howto.md` (about 60 lines: gather merged PRs since the last tag, group by label, draft the notes, get a thumbs-up, post). we do it every release
evals.expected_output: Phase 0's three questions are answered explicitly and the nearest neighbour named, then the scaffolder dry run is shown before `--write`, the trigger set and description come first, and the behavioral eval is scheduled before any lock-in tests.
assertions: The three Phase 0 questions (invoked 2+ times, more than ~20 lines of judgment, a trigger phrase) are each answered explicitly
The scaffolder is run as a dry run and its plan is read before `--write`
The behavioral eval (Phase 4) is scheduled before the lock-in tests (Phase 5)
The nearest-neighbour skill is named, or the skill is stated to have none

evals.prompt: skillify the deploy script in my other repo, `~/projects/acme-portal/scripts/deploy.sh`, so the agent there can run it as a skill
evals.expected_output: A decline with the repo-only reason: skillify builds and scores skills for this monorepo only; the response points at what would apply in another repository instead of scaffolding anything.
assertions: The response declines and states that skillify is for skills inside this repository only
No scaffolding is run and no file is created
The response points at an alternative for the other repository
